name: saffra
description: Saffra — Restaurant Operating System. Tables, kitchen and payments — in one flow.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run prepare:resources --workspace apps/desktop && npm run dist:win --workspace apps/desktop
